scholarships.title: Václav Havel Bursary - Charles University
scholarships.degree: Any degree programme at a Charles University faculty (undergraduate, master's or doctoral)

existing.description: The Václav Havel Bursary is Charles University's own financial support for international students whose studies are hindered or prevented by repression under totalitarian, authoritarian or other non-democratic regimes anywhere in the world. Students from countries where humanitarian organisations report violated human rights and freedoms and where discriminatory measures restrict access to education may apply, provided they have already been admitted and enrolled in a degree programme at a Charles University faculty through the standard admissions procedure. Students submit the application to the Student Affairs Office of their faculty, which forwards it digitally through the Dean to the Chair of the Václav Havel Bursary Board. As part of the preparation for studies in the Czech language, applicants may also request a contribution towards living expenses.
eligibility: International student whose studies are hindered or prevented by repression under totalitarian, authoritarian or other non-democratic regimes anywhere in the world

Applying for the living-expense contribution requires that the studies are being prepared in the Czech language
